notes: This is a simple text-match checker, not a medical device. Always read the actual label if there is any doubt.
Soy lecithin and 'may contain traces of milk/soya' warnings are treated as allergen hits here - use the manual override if you've separately confirmed a product is safe.
FODMAP triggers are shown as a caution, not a block, since tolerance is dose-dependent and personal.
